# Calckoo

> Free, accurate health, fitness, nutrition, and finance calculators for a global audience, with a focus on Brunei and Southeast Asia.

Calckoo provides 64+ free online calculators across health, fitness, nutrition, pregnancy, children, medical, finance, education, and unit conversion categories. Every calculator includes the underlying formula, an explanation of what the result means, and links to related tools. Site available in English, Bahasa Melayu Brunei, and Bahasa Indonesia (UI only; long-form articles are in English).

## Calculators by category

### Health
- [BMI Calculator](https://calckoo.com/calculators/bmi-calculator): Check your Body Mass Index.
- [Body Fat Calculator](https://calckoo.com/calculators/body-fat-calculator): Estimate your body fat percentage.
- [Lean Body Mass Calculator](https://calckoo.com/calculators/lean-body-mass-calculator): Calculate mass excluding fat.
- [Ideal Weight Calculator](https://calckoo.com/calculators/ideal-weight-calculator): Find your ideal body weight range.
- [BMR Calculator](https://calckoo.com/calculators/bmr-calculator): Basal Metabolic Rate at rest.
- [Waist to Height Ratio](https://calckoo.com/calculators/waist-to-height-ratio-calculator): A simple cardiovascular risk metric.
- [Waist Hip Ratio Calculator](https://calckoo.com/calculators/waist-hip-ratio-calculator): Body fat distribution indicator.
- [Body Adiposity Index Calculator](https://calckoo.com/calculators/bai-calculator): Estimate body fat % from hip and height alone.
- [Body Frame Size Calculator](https://calckoo.com/calculators/frame-size-calculator): Find your body frame size from wrist circumference.

- [Walking Calories Calculator](https://calckoo.com/calculators/walking-calories-calculator): Calories burned while walking.
- [One Rep Max Calculator](https://calckoo.com/calculators/one-rep-max-calculator): Estimate your 1RM and training load percentages.
- [Running Calories Calculator](https://calckoo.com/calculators/running-calories-calculator): Calories burned while running, by pace.

### Medical

### Finance

- [Compound Interest Calculator](https://calckoo.com/calculators/compound-interest-calculator): Grow savings with compounding and contributions.
- [Simple Interest Calculator](https://calckoo.com/calculators/simple-interest-calculator): Quick simple interest on a principal amount.
- [Savings Goal Calculator](https://calckoo.com/calculators/savings-goal-calculator): Monthly savings needed to hit a target.
- [Investment Return Calculator](https://calckoo.com/calculators/investment-return-calculator): Total and annualized investment returns.
- [Tip Calculator](https://calckoo.com/calculators/tip-calculator): Split a bill with tip across any number of people.

- [Mortgage Affordability Calculator](https://calckoo.com/calculators/mortgage-affordability-calculator): How much home you can afford (28/36 rule).

- [Length Converter](https://calckoo.com/calculators/length-converter): Convert between metres, feet, miles and more.
- [Weight Converter](https://calckoo.com/calculators/weight-converter): Convert between kg, lb, oz and stone.

- [Volume Converter](https://calckoo.com/calculators/volume-converter): Convert between litres, cups, gallons and more.
- [Speed Converter](https://calckoo.com/calculators/speed-converter): Convert between km/h, mph and knots.
- [Time Converter](https://calckoo.com/calculators/time-converter): Convert between seconds, hours, days and weeks.
- [Area Converter](https://calckoo.com/calculators/area-converter): Convert between m², acres, hectares and more.
- [Data Storage Converter](https://calckoo.com/calculators/data-storage-converter): Convert between KB, MB, GB and TB.

### Education
